description: Read-only runtime schema discovery for ERP public data entities, distinct from Dataverse schema authoring.
defaultAssertions: PRIORITY_1: No tables, columns, solutions, X++ artifacts, or business records are created or modified.
PRIORITY_2: Executed dataverse commands carry app, the routed skill, and agent attribution.

tests.prompt: Inspect the existing Finance and Operations CustomerGroups schema: list its key fields, property names and types, navigation properties, and any bound actions exposed in this environment. Schema inspection only, not business records or a schema change.
tests.expected_response: The agent loads dv-metadata for schema inspection and follows ERP routing to dataverse data describe --target erp --table CustomerGroups --json or equivalent ERP MCP metadata discovery. It reports actual runtime keys, properties, navigations, and actions, including empty arrays, without downloading full metadata or trying actions.
tests.description: Inspect ERP runtime entity metadata without Dataverse schema APIs.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The trajectory inspects CustomerGroups on the ERP target through data describe or equivalent ERP MCP metadata discovery, not DataverseClient.tables or EntityDefinitions.
PRIORITY_1: OUTCOME: Keys, property types, navigation properties, and bound actions are grounded in returned runtime metadata, or an actual access/discovery blocker is reported.
PRIORITY_1: Empty Actions means no exposed bound actions; the agent does not guess or invoke an action to discover it.
